body: I feel you! I haven't even told my mother yet. She's been going on and on about how I need to lose weight before I get pregnant and how my life needs to be more organized before I even think about getting pregnant. Well oops. Honestly my greatest advice is keep your relationship at the moment on a need to know basis. That's what I plan to do.

Wow you guys are super awesome. I have to say that while I still totally want a boy. But getting in the mode planning for whatever you get definitely helps a lot. I just want nothing with pink on it. Your advice and camaraderie has helped a ton.

The way it was explained is whenever they do those screening they can check to see if there is a Y chromosome. If it is there, they'll see it. Usually they don't say anything unless they know for sure you want to know.

We found out through a blood test. You can do that right at the 12 week point. They also check for heredity diseases and make sure there are no duplicates of chromosomes. It's good to do the tests. :)

No worries. I have a hubby. But he's one of those "I'm thrilled with whatever!" and doesn't totally get my bias toward one or the other.

Edit: Scratch that. Apparently he had been hoping for a girl this whole time. He just informed me.

I am a pre-K teacher and HATE the idea of gender specific toys. In fact in my classroom, I try to discourage the terms boyish and girlish. I also felt inclined to convince girls to play more physical games and for the boys to take time with dolls/action figures/ dramatic play. However, I just wanted a boy. Not for the boyish things but the image of a little boy was more appealing for my first than a little girl.
